import math

def american_price(S, K, T, r, q, sigma, is_call):
    N = 150
    dt = T / N

    u = math.exp(sigma * math.sqrt(dt))
    d = 1.0 / u
    pu = (math.exp((r - q) * dt) - d) / (u - d)
    pu = 0.0 if pu < 0.0 else 1.0 if pu > 1.0 else pu
    pd = 1.0 - pu
    disc = math.exp(-r * dt)
    ratio = u / d

    stocks = [0.0] * (N + 1)
    values = [0.0] * (N + 1)

    s = S * (d ** N)

    if is_call:
        for j in range(N + 1):
            stocks[j] = s
            payoff = s - K
            values[j] = payoff if payoff > 0.0 else 0.0
            s *= ratio
    else:
        for j in range(N + 1):
            stocks[j] = s
            payoff = K - s
            values[j] = payoff if payoff > 0.0 else 0.0
            s *= ratio

    if is_call:
        for i in range(N - 1, -1, -1):
            for j in range(i + 1):
                s_i = stocks[j] * u
                stocks[j] = s_i
                cont = disc * (pu * values[j + 1] + pd * values[j])
                intr = s_i - K
                if intr < 0.0:
                    intr = 0.0
                values[j] = cont if cont > intr else intr
    else:
        for i in range(N - 1, -1, -1):
            for j in range(i + 1):
                s_i = stocks[j] * u
                stocks[j] = s_i
                cont = disc * (pu * values[j + 1] + pd * values[j])
                intr = K - s_i
                if intr < 0.0:
                    intr = 0.0
                values[j] = cont if cont > intr else intr

    return values[0]

    Real S, Real X, Real rf, Real q, Real v, Real t) const {
